C, CFCs. HCFCs were used as transitional replacements for chlorofluorocarbons in refrigeration. “Replacement” does not mean harmless: HCFCs also deplete ozone and are themselves being phased out. [EPA, Phaseout of Class II Ozone-Depleting Substances](https://www.epa.gov/ods-phaseout/phaseout-class-ii-ozone-depleting-substances).

Update — checked 19 November 2026: India's Ozone Cell lists a 67.5% HCFC reduction step for 2025 in its phase-out schedule. This is a scheduled control step, not a claim here that a measured reduction of exactly 67.5% was achieved. Keep the historical answer CFCs; the question is not recommending HCFCs for a new appliance today. [Ozone Cell, HCFC Phase-out Management Plan](https://ozonecell.nic.in/home-page/montreal-protocol-implementation-in-india/ods-phaseout-in-the-country/page-hcfc-phaseout-management-plan/).

publications.paper_id: Old_Questions/Direct_2023-2025/MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Paper-II Series 'C'.pdf
publications.explanation: C, emotional intelligence, is the intended term. It includes recognising and understanding emotional signals and managing emotions in oneself and in interactions with others. For example, noticing a colleague's frustration, understanding its context and responding constructively draws on these abilities. Self-evaluation is the narrower act of assessing oneself. “Emotional competence” is closely related, so do not treat B and C as completely unrelated concepts; C matches the definition used by this question. [OpenStax, Emotional Intelligence](https://openstax.org/books/principles-management/pages/2-2-how-the-brain-processes-information-to-make-decisions-reflective-and-reactive-systems).

D, RINGLET. Match each position in LIGHT with 1–5: L=1, I=2, G=3, H=4, T=5. ENDURE gives E=6, N=7, D=8, U=9, R=10, E=6. The repeated E confirms that 6 is reused.

Now split 10273165 as 10 | 2 | 7 | 3 | 1 | 6 | 5. Substituting gives R | I | N | G | L | E | T. Here 10 is one code value, not the separate digits 1 and 0. This is the direct letter-to-number substitution specified in the printed directions.

publications.paper_id: Old_Questions/Direct_2023-2025/MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Paper-II Series 'C'.pdf
publications.explanation: C, brain, is the intended odd word. Tongue, lips and nose are externally visible structures of the face or mouth; the brain is an internal organ enclosed within the skull. Use that grouping, rather than claiming the other three are all sense organs: lips do not form a separate conventional sense organ, and the brain also participates in processing sensory information.
